name: Northeast Ridge

waypoints.name: Trinity Trailhead (Buck Creek Trailhead)
waypoints.directions: From US-2 at Coles Corner, take SR 207 north 4.3 miles and bear right onto Chiwawa Loop Road, then turn left onto the Chiwawa River Road (FR 62) and follow it about 23 miles, paved and then gravel, to the large Trinity lot just before the gate at the road end. The last stretch is rough and rutted; high clearance helps. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park, and a free wilderness permit is self-issued at the trailhead.

beta: Very little beta exists online for this line beyond a single forum report: it follows the left side of the visible northeast face, with steeper rock and snow options further right of uncertain quality/rock condition. Expect a mixed rock-and-snow outing rather than a simple scramble, with a rope needed for the pitched rock section. One climber who used it noted that the published descriptions of it are inaccurate.
